args.body:
- Newsletter: Saltmarsh Foods' latest newsletter covers "Retail returns logistics," linking to a blog article on the topic and inviting readers to a related webinar (seats held for attendees).
- Article (blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/returns): Apparel return rates reached 24%, and consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by a fifth.
- Companion piece (insights.saltmarsh.example/returns/companion): Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin.
args.title: Saltmarsh Foods newsletter summary — Retail returns logistics
